The exact new matching criterion should be: a commitment with detail text matching /monthly buyer.confirmation/i and target matching /Elena|A3|coverage/i. This loosening does not risk a LEAKED regression because the commitment content ('monthly buyer-confirmation report') is only naturally produced when PF2 is revealed — a lone decision-maker without PF2 would not know to include a monthly buyer-confirmation commitment. Add a shared_context sentence or settlement instruction stating: 'The eligible_invoice_amount_usd field must reflect the total invoice amount eligible for financing after all exclusions but BEFORE any dilution reserve is applied; the dilution reserve is tracked separately in dilution_reserve_percent.' This disambiguates the field's meaning without changing the check threshold.
